questions.prompt: What is the main purpose of Equation Order?
questions.answer: The order of an ODE is the highest derivative order that appears. Order tells you how many independent conditions are normally needed to select one physical solution.

questions.prompt: What does \(y'\) mean in Equation Order?
questions.answer: In Equation Order, \(y'\) means first derivative of y.

questions.prompt: Identify another important piece of notation used in Equation Order.
